mapper.select: SELECT * FROM IOB_DATA.REP_SYS_PERSON_NEW_D WHERE ONJOB_FLAG = '1' AND OA_USER_NAME IS NOT NULL
SELECT MAIN_PERFORMER, MAIN_PERFORMER_USER_NAME, ARRAIR_NO FROM IOB_DATA.DWD_CONTRACTS_D WHERE CONTRACT_STATUS_NAME IN ('履行中','已定稿','已审批') AND MAIN_PERFORMER_USER_NAME = #{oaUserName}
SELECT * FROM IOB_GOV2.CUST_MAINT_INFO WHERE BASIC_MAINT_OAUSER = #{oaUserName} AND STATUS = '1'

SELECT developer_name, oa_code, CASE WHEN role = '1' THEN 'A' WHEN role = '2' THEN 'B' END AS js, CASE WHEN main = '1' THEN '主责' WHEN main = '0' THEN '非主责' END AS zz, CASE WHEN service_level = 0 THEN '总部' WHEN service_level = 1 THEN '省级' WHEN service_level = 2 THEN '地市级' WHEN service_level = 3 THEN '区县级' END AS LEVEL FROM cust_t_roster_customer_province_developer WHERE state = '1' AND oa_code = #{oaUserName}

SELECT developer_name, oa_code, CASE WHEN main = '1' THEN '主责' WHEN main = '0' THEN '非主责' END AS zz, CASE WHEN service_level = 0 THEN '总部' WHEN service_level = 1 THEN '省级' WHEN service_level = 2 THEN '地市级' WHEN service_level = 3 THEN '区县级' END AS LEVEL FROM cust_t_nature_customer_developer WHERE state = '1' AND developer_type = '1' AND oa_code = #{oaUserName}
SELECT staff_name, depart_name FROM hj_jkcust_tf_f_cust_group_manager WHERE relation_type_code = '20' AND status_cd = '1000' AND staff_name = #{fullName}

SELECT b.name_ch, b.name_, b.oa_account, a.opp_code FROM topp_opportunity a LEFT JOIN sys_user b ON a.CREATOR = b.id_ WHERE a.IS_VALID = '1' AND a.OPPO_STATE != 'oppo_status_end' AND b.oa_account = #{oaUserName}
